user.title: Sign in to Dibber
user.description: Submitting sends a login request and may initiate an email verification step. Enter your own caregiver credentials. Your password and code are never saved.

code.title: Verify sign-in
code.description: Enter your Dibber email access code. Its validity is controlled by Dibber; it is not stored.

children.title: Choose calendars
children.description: Select children to create read-only calendars. If discovery failed, submit again to retry.

error.invalid_auth: Sign-in was rejected. Check your credentials or code.
error.unsupported_auth: This integration supports provisioned caregiver DibberMFA accounts only.
error.access_denied: Dibber denied access to this resource. Check caregiver access in the app.
error.rate_limited: Dibber requested a pause. Wait before trying again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to contact Dibber. Try again later.
error.renewal_uncertain: A token renewal response was lost. Use Reconfigure to sign in again; automatic renewal is paused to avoid replaying a rotated token.
error.invalid_response: Dibber returned an unsupported response. Please report the error without personal data.
error.password_expired: Dibber reports an expired password. Update it in Dibber, then sign in again.
error.select_children: Select at least one accessible child.

abort.already_configured: This Dibber account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the same Dibber account as this integration.
abort.no_children: No accessible children were found. Check your caregiver account in Dibber.
